name: ScroBot
description: A compact macro and gameplay utility menu with editable controls, replay tools, visual options and performance settings. Press Tab + W on desktop or tap the floating orb on touch devices.

open-menu.name: Open Menu (PC)
open-menu.description: Shows or hides the mod panels.

ui-theme.name: Menu Theme
ui-theme.description: Auto uses light on desktop and dark on mobile. You can override it.
